subject: Next steps: OrbitalTech probe matrix + hallucination/regression plan
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@orbitaltech.com>, Matt Johnson <matt@orbitaltech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2027 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Next steps: OrbitalTech probe matrix + hallucination/regression plan

Hi Elena / Matt —

Thanks again for a productive demo today. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we have alignment before we spin up the sandbox runs: 

1) Evaluation goals (what OrbitalTech cares about):
   - Minimize hallucination in product spec answers (domain-specific engineering docs)
   - Consistent latency under 300ms p50 for single-turn API calls
   - Cost delta vs current hyperscaler baseline <= 20% for production mix

2) Proposed probe matrix (attached): inference-probe-matrix.xlsx
   - Prompt buckets: "Spec extraction", "API usage examples", "Troubleshooting Q&A", "Small code transform"
   - Metrics we will capture per prompt: hallucination_flag (binary), factuality_score (human-rated 0-3), latency_ms, token_usage, rerank_need
   - Models to compare: your current hyperscaler endpoint (provides API key), Redwood hosted LLM baseline (gptx-small), Redwood quantized variant (q4_8k)

3) Regression & hallucination checks:
   - Seeded prompt set (100 prompts) + blind holdout (20) for stability checks
   - Acceptable hallucination threshold: <= 6% on holdout for the first pass
   - If hallucination > 6%, run targeted temperature sweeps + factuality-aware reranking

4) Logistics / next actions:
   - OrbitalTech to share a read-only API key to their hyperscaler eval endpoint (one week access) — Matt?
   - We will provision a sandbox and run batch probes, deliver a CSV with example failures and suggested mitigations within 3 business days after keys received
   - NDA: please sign the attached orbital-ma-nda.pdf so we can share logs for root-cause analysis

Attachments: inference-probe-matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet), orbital-ma-nda.pdf (PDF)
Recording: call recording available on request

If that matches your expectations I’ll schedule the sandbox run for Thursday.

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
From: Elena Park <elena@orbitaltech.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: Matt Johnson <matt@orbitaltech.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2027 16:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Next steps: OrbitalTech probe matrix + hallucination/regression plan

Jonas —

This looks great, thanks for the clear breakdown. A couple quick notes: 
- We can provide a time-limited API key to our hyperscaler test endpoint (Matt will send by EOD).
- Hallucination threshold of 6% is reasonable as a first cut; our internal bar is around 3% but we can accept a phased rollout.
- I reviewed the probe buckets and added one more: "Release notes summarization" (we frequently auto-generate summaries for customer-facing notes).

Matt — can you send the key + an example curl request that matches our prod headers?

Elena
Elena Park
Head of ML Engineering, OrbitalTech
elena@orbitaltech.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@orbitaltech.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Nov 2027 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Next steps: OrbitalTech probe matrix + hallucination/regression plan

Thanks Elena — adding the "Release notes summarization" bucket to the matrix now. Jon / Ben:

Operational checklist I will own for the sandbox run:
- Provision RBAC-limited sandbox in us-west-2 and map OrbitalTech key to a read-only route
- Confirm sampling distribution (we will mirror OrbitalTech prod: 45% spec extraction, 25% troubleshooting Q&A, 15% release summaries, 10% API usage examples, 5% code transforms)
- Implement automated hallucination heuristic: if output contains entity not present in context + confidence_score < 0.6 -> mark hallucination
- Produce deliverables: CSV of prompt-level results, 20 prioritized failure cases with suggested mitigations, short slide deck (3 slides) summarizing deltas and recommended config changes

Tentative schedule: sandbox runs Thursday (Dec 2) morning PST, initial deliverables Friday EOD. Please confirm if that timeline works for OrbitalTech.

Ben — please pre-check that the quantized model path is enabled in the sandbox and that token accounting is on.

Cheers,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Solutions & Customer Success | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
